notes_for_editor: Pre-1900 history (1859 tower, 1867 fire, fog gun, 1890 revolving light) rests on Lighthouse Friends alone; Canadian reports before fiscal 1900 are not in the corpus. Height disagreement: 1909 report 97 ft to vane (29.6 m), Lighthouse Friends 108 ft (33 m), record 32.9 m. National historic site year disagrees (1974 vs 1976). Keeper roster is from Lighthouse Friends only (no USLHS for Canada); McWilliams appears in two consecutive stints there. Marine reports are cited by Internet Archive volume; the corpus labels the 1909 tower volume '1909' though the identifier says 1910, so the fiscal year was not stated in the story; check. The report volume also hit 'Father Point' wireless table (1910) not used. Parks Canada's designation page (id=14633) would not load. The Empress of Ireland death toll is from Parks Canada (1,012). The Wikipedia leads were not cited. Visit hours: Parks Canada page said closed for the season on 2026-10-27. Death toll: Parks Canada and Lighthouse Friends say 1,012, the 1916-volume Marine report (printed p. 201) says 1,042; both stated in the story. The 1916 volume's fiscal year was not confirmed, so the story calls it the report published in 1916. Design credit: Department report names H. de Miffonis as building the tower, Lighthouse Friends credits his design, Canadian Register credits Anderson; the story states both. Keeper roster and dates are Lighthouse Friends' list only; the 1903 Marine report table independently shows John J. McWilliams appointed 1 June 1876 at Father Point.
